faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.cancelQuestion: Can I cancel at any time?
faq.cancelAnswer: Yes, you can cancel whenever you want with a single click. You will keep all Pro benefits until the end of the period already billed.
faq.paymentQuestion: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.paymentAnswer: We accept Mercado Pago, credit cards, debit cards, and secure local bank transfers.
faq.dataQuestion: What happens to my data and lists if I return to the Free plan?
faq.dataAnswer: Absolutely no data is lost. All your lists, tasks, and notes will remain intact and secure.

visibility.title: Visibility and privacy
visibility.desc: Configure how other users can discover or interact with you inside Alino.
visibility.privateAccountDesc: You will not appear in user searches or be suggested for invites.
visibility.privateSuccessOn: Private account activated. Your profile will not appear in searches.
visibility.privateSuccessOff: Public account. Other users can find you to invite you.
visibility.listInvitesDesc: If turned off, no one will be able to send you requests to join shared lists.
visibility.listInvitesSuccessOff: Invites blocked. No one can add you to shared lists.
visibility.activityStatusDesc: Shows when you are active or completing tasks to collaborators on your lists.
visibility.activityStatusSuccessOn: Real-time activity visible to your collaborators.

dangerZone.deleteSuccess: Your account has been deleted. Goodbye.
